title: Türkiye Energy Intelligence Platform
description: EnerjiNabız AI is an open-source platform for Turkish electricity-market data ingestion, quality control, time-series analytics, forecasting, anomaly detection, visualization and BI-ready exports. Version 1.1.1 is a metadata-consistency patch: it preserves the secure hosted Live EPİAŞ integration introduced in v1.1.0 while correcting the package and machine-readable citation version embedded in the source archive.
